metadata.description:
Here's 90 minutes of the Rap Exchange from September '99. Mobb Deep are in the studio ahead of the Murda Muzik launch party at The Tunnel that coming Sunday. No freestyle unfortunately but Flex gets busy cutting up some bangers.

Track List
  • DMX f/The LOX & Mase – N!ggaz Done Started Something
  • Redman f/Busta Rhymes – Da Goodness
  • Puff Daddy f/The LOX, Lil Kim & Notorious B.I.G. – It’s All About the Benjamins (Remix)
  • Party Break – Bounce With Me
  • Lil Cease f/Mr. Bristal, Tone Hooker & Lil Kim – Play Around
  • Mobb Deep – Interview
  • JAY-Z – Girl’s Best Friend
  • Memphis Bleek – Memphis Bleek Is
  • Mobb Deep f/Lil Kim – Quiet Storm (Remix)
  • Mobb Deep – Interview
  • Mobb Deep f/Cormega – What's Ya Poison
  • Mobb Deep – Interview
  • Crooklyn Clan – Say Wut
  • Noreaga – Oh No
  • Busta Rhymes – Tear Da Roof Off
  • GZA – Breaker Breaker
  • Crooklyn Clan – Franklinz
  • Ruff Ryders f/Drag-On & Juvenile – Down Bottom
  • Busta Rhymes – Do It Like Never Before
  • Ruff Ryders f/Eve – Watch Y’all Want
  • Busta Rhymes – Do the Bus a Bus
  • Notorious B.I.G. – Real N!ggaz Do Real Things
  • Crooklyn Clan – Be Faithful
  • Gang Starr f/Nice & Smooth – DWYCK
  • Ruff Ryders f/JAY-Z – Jigga My N!gga
  • The LOX f/Notorious B.I.G. – You’ll See
  • Notorious B.I.G. – 10 Crack Commandments
  • Eve f/Drag-On – Let’s Talk About
- DJ Step One (write-up), Brian M (track list)
